home.title: Kimono colors in your everyday life – Otonarashi
home.description: Otonarashi, the official upcycled kimono brand by Kanon Nishikyo-goku Workshop. An e-commerce site dedicated to bringing the traditional beauty of kimono into your daily life.

products.title: Products – Otonarashi
products.description: One-of-a-kind upcycled kimono products. Each piece is unique in pattern and texture, making it truly special. Explore kimono styles that can be incorporated into your everyday life.

aboutus.title: Artisans – Otonarashi
aboutus.description: Meet the team behind Otonarashi. Each piece is carefully handcrafted by users attending the Kanon Nishikyo-goku Workshop, who are dedicated to traditional handcrafting techniques. Discover the collaborative spirit and background of Otonarashi's craftsmanship.

aboutUs.paragraph1: No two things in this world are exactly alike.
aboutUs.paragraph2:
The kimonos that become Otonarashi products
are donated by people from the local community.

Each kimono holds irreplaceable stories—
filled with memories or recalling someone dear.
We breathe new life into these kimonos.
aboutUs.paragraph3: Each pattern and texture is truly one-of-a-kind.
aboutUs.paragraph4:
Otonarashi items are special,
existing only once in this world.

kanonSection.title: Hand-sewn by Kanon
kanonSection.paragraph1:
Otonarashi products are made at
Kanon Nishikyogoku Workshop.
kanonSection.paragraph2:
The workshop is attended by
individuals with developmental disabilities.
kanonSection.paragraph3:
Each piece is finished with careful,
hand-sewn stitches.
kanonSection.paragraph4:
Sewing is joyful work that makes 
the most of each member's unique strengths.
kanonSection.paragraph5:
Otonarashi was born from its exhibition at
EXPO 2025 Osaka Kansai.
kanonSection.paragraph6:
Its product planning and production 
were developed in collaboration with 
the Hanataba Project.
kanonSection.paragraph7:
This initiative is supported by a grant from
the Toshiba International Foundation.
